name: vibeknow-design-video
description: Motion-style text video expert by vibeknow

displayDescription.zh: 给个文件或一篇文章，自动排版式、配图、配音，编排成一条动效流畅、有设计感的图文短视频。
displayDescription.en: Give a file or an article — auto-lays out templates, adds imagery and voiceover, and choreographs a smooth, design-forward motion text video.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把这段内容做成一条动效流畅的图文短视频 —— 直接粘贴文档，或说个主题（比如“三分钟看懂复利”）
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn this into a smooth motion text video — paste a document, or name a topic (e.g. compound interest in 3 minutes)
